name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
summary: Kibler asks you to gather Spire Spider Eggs at Blackrock Spire. He needs fifteen, and the eggs are found near spiders.

sections.title: Near the Spiders
sections.body: The eggs are said to lie near spiders. At Blackrock Spire, Kibler asks you to bring him fifteen Spire Spider Eggs.

faq.q: Who wants the Spire Spider Eggs?
faq.answer: Kibler asks you to collect fifteen Spire Spider Eggs.
The eggs can be found near spiders at Blackrock Spire.

faq.q: How many eggs does Kibler need?
faq.answer: Kibler asks for fifteen Spire Spider Eggs.
